scenes.text: If you could travel back to October 1582, you’d find a massive chunk of human history is completely missing.
Seriously, people went to sleep on October fourth and woke up the very next morning on October fifteenth.
Pope Gregory the Thirteenth realized the old Julian calendar was slightly misaligned with the Earth's orbit, causing Easter to drift away from the spring equinox.
Would you support changing our modern calendar again? Let me know in the comments and follow.
